This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.337/2023 dated 11.08.2023 registered at Police Station Pipariya, District Narmadapuram for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 368,
376(2)(n), 376(3) and 506 of IPC and Sections 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in jail since 16.08.2023.

sentences.text: Therefore, the present applicant may also be released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
The age of prosecutrix in this case was below 15 years at the time of incident.

6. This bail application has been argued on the ground that the prosecutrix was in love relationship with the present applicant and for this, some photographs have been filed to reveal their relationship.
The statements of prosecutrix given under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. have been examined.
Having considered her young age, consent of prosecutrix is of no relevance.
6. Taking into consideration the gravity of matter, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
